description.fun: Scyther moves so fast it can't be followed, like a ninja, and slices through a massive tree in a single stroke, keeping its scythes sharp by cutting hard things. It has wings but rarely flies, and its green body lets it vanish into grass and forest. It's the only Pokémon whose two evolutions both arrived after it did: Scizor in Generation 2 and Kleavor in Legends: Arceus.
description.guide: A green, mantis-like Bug and Flying Pokémon with large scythes for arms. It is extremely fast and hunts in grasslands and forests. It evolves into Scizor when traded holding a Metal Coat, or into Kleavor with a Black Augurite.
description.tagline: A ninja mantis that fells trees in one slice

branches.text: Scyther has two futures, both added after it: trading it while it holds a Metal Coat turns it into Scizor, a steel-bodied Bug and Steel type from Generation 2, while a Black Augurite, a rare volcanic stone from Hisui, turns it into Kleavor, a Bug and Rock type with stone axes for arms, from Legends: Arceus.

description.fun: Scizor's body is as hard as steel, and its pincers can crush anything; they're marked with eyespots, so when it raises them it looks like it has three heads. It can't really fly, flapping its wings mainly to keep its body from overheating and melting, though it can hover and glide a little. Its name blends 'scissors' and 'razor'.
description.guide: One of Scyther's two final forms, introduced in Generation 2, a red Bug and Steel Pokémon with a steel-hard body and large pincers marked with eye-like spots. It evolves when Scyther is traded holding a Metal Coat. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Scizor.
description.tagline: Steel pincers with eyes painted on

description.fun: Its pincers grow longer and barbed, sharp enough to stab through concrete, and a samurai-like crest appears on its head. Mega Evolution floods it with so much energy that it can't regulate its temperature, so if the form lasts too long, its body starts to melt.

A rare volcanic stone, Black Augurite, turned Scyther's scythes into heavy axes of black stone in ancient Hisui. Kleavor chops down trees to mark its territory, and the bigger the chips in its stone, the more battles it has fought. Hisui's settlers collected the shards that broke off and made tools from them. Today it may be close to extinction.
description.guide: One of Scyther's two final forms, a Bug and Rock Pokémon introduced in Pokémon Legends: Arceus. Scyther evolves into it when exposed to a Black Augurite, and its arms are heavy axes of black stone. It is hostile and very rare in the present day.
description.tagline: A mantis with stone axes, chipped from many battles
